about.heading: Computer Science graduate connecting technology and banking
paragraphs: I am a Computer Science graduate from the University of Dodoma with practical experience in software development, database-backed applications, applied machine learning, and IT support. I enjoy turning operational needs into useful systems, with attention to usability, maintainability, and reliable data.

I currently work as a Management Trainee at I&M Bank Tanzania. Before joining the bank, I completed an ICT/software development internship at the National Housing Corporation, where I built and contributed to internal business systems. My long-term interests include digital banking, data engineering and architecture, AI, cybersecurity, and technology-led transformation.
